name: Eachlach Urlair

attributes.attribute: a feminine spirit, a bogie or a witch
believed to live near castles and serve their residents
came from the Otherworld, not the human world

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Eachlach Urlair is a Scottish folkloric figure. This spirit is female and is a bogie or a witch. She was believed to live near castles. She offered residents mysterious service of no fixed kind. Her name came to mean any domestic servant. Highland lore says she began not in the human world but in the Otherworld.

okr.objective: Describe Eachlach Urlair as a Scottish household spirit.
key_results: Eachlach Urlair is a feminine Scottish spirit.
She was a bogie or a witch who lived near castles.
Her name came to mean any domestic servant.
Highland lore places her origin in the Otherworld.
